description: WhatsApp is said to be working on a new security feature that would let users replace the existing two-step verification PIN with a password. Currently, the Meta-owned platform offers a six-digit numeric PIN for two-step verification. This change allows users to keep a password comprising both letters and numbers.
title: WhatsApp Could Replace Two-Step Verification PIN With a Stronger Password

description: Boat has launched the Nirvana Eutopia 2 ANC in India with a dual-driver setup, support for up to 45dB Adaptive Hybrid ANC and a claimed battery life of up to 80 hours. The over-ear headphones also support Hi-Res Audio, 3D Spatial Audio, LDAC, Bluetooth 5.4, Google Fast Pair and AI ENx calling. Other features include multi-device connectivity, the Boat Hearables app, an IPX4-rated foldable design and fast charging. The headset starts at a special launch price of Rs. 4,999.
title: Boat Nirvana Eutopia 2 ANC Launched in India With 45dB Hybrid ANC, Up to 80 Hours of Battery Life: Price, Features

description: Google announced a new Selfie Video sign-in and account recovery method. This feature lets users verify their identity with a short selfie video. With this update, users can regain access to Google Accounts if they are locked out or dont have access to their usual phone or computer. Google assured that users will have full control over their videos, and they can delete the stored selfie video from their Google Account at any time.
title: Google Introduces Selfie Video Sign-In for Account Recovery

description: A fresh leak from South Korea suggests Samsung could significantly upgrade the Galaxy Z Fold 9 Ultra's cameras by replacing its existing telephoto unit with a 50-megapixel 5x periscope sensor and introducing a new 200-megapixel HP6 primary camera. The report also hints at a different camera strategy for the standard Galaxy Z Fold 9, while linking the Ultra model's rumoured hardware to earlier Galaxy S27 Ultra leaks.
title: Samsung Galaxy Z Fold 9 Ultra May Match Galaxy S27 Ultra With 200-Megapixel Camera, 5x Periscope Zoom

description: Bitcoin traded near $65,000 as institutional demand remained resilient despite inflation concerns and geopolitical risks. Analysts said the upcoming Fed meeting and resistance near $69,000 will shape the market’s next move.
title: Bitcoin Holds Near $65,000 as ETF Demand Counters Inflation Concerns

description: Xiaomi has unveiled the Power Bank 5i 20000 67W in India. The accessory features a built-in USB Type-C cable, support for multiple fast charging standards and a smart digital display. It can charge several compatible devices simultaneously and supports both high-speed output and input charging. The power bank is priced at Rs. 3,499 and will be available through Xiaomi's online store, Amazon India and retail outlets from July 28.
title: Xiaomi Power Bank 5i 20000 67W With Built-In USB Type-C Cable Launched in India: Price, Features

description: With the launch of the new generation Galaxy foldables in the rear window, the focus is shifting to the Made by Google event, where the Pixel 11 series is expected to be launched. While the Mountain View-based tech giant has yet to reveal any details about its upcoming devices, alleged press renders of the upcoming flagship models have reportedly surfaced, revealing their design and possible colour options.
title: Google Pixel 11, Pixel 11 Pro, Pixel 11 Pro XL Design, Colourways Reportedly Leak via Renders Ahead of Launch

description: This week's OTT lineup brings Vikrant Massey's Musafir Cafe and Kay Kay Menon's Adarsh Baal Vidyalaya to Netflix and Prime Video, alongside Tovino Thomas' Pallichattambi, a true-crime documentary, and the long-awaited finale of Bleach: Thousand-Year Blood War.
title: New OTT Releases This Week (July 20 - July 26): Musafir Cafe, Adarsh Baal Vidyalaya, Pallichattambi, Stuart Fails to Save the Universe, and More

description: Poco F9 Ultra and Poco F9 Pro reportedly spotted in the IMEI database. The smartphones have also picked up certifications in multiple regions, indicating a global launch is likely drawing closer. They have also appeared on the Infocomm Media Development Authority (IMDA) certification site and Indonesia's Tingkat Komponen Dalam Negeri (TKDN) certification website.  The global version of the Vivo X500 also appeared on this platform.
title: Poco F9 Ultra, Poco F9 Pro Spotted on Multiple Certification Sites Ahead of Launch

description: Redmi has started teasing the launch of a new Note series smartphone in India. Apart from this, a dedicated microsite for the launch of the new Note series phone is now live on the Xiaomi India website, hinting that it will go on sale in the country via the company’s online store. However, it is worth noting that the company has yet to confirm the name and the exact launch date of the upcoming Redmi Note series smartphone. This comes a few weeks ahead of the anticipated launch of the Redmi Note 17 in India. Recently, a report highlighted that the handset will be unveiled in the country on August 6, while going on sale in the country on August 11.
title: New Redmi Note India Launch Appears Imminent After Official Teaser Goes Live; Could be Redmi Note 17

description: Vivo S2 has surfaced in a fresh leak ahead of its expected India debut, revealing its storage variants, colour options and internal retail listing prices. The handset is tipped to launch in 8GB + 128GB and 8GB + 256GB variants in Sapphire Blue, Regal Bronze and Silk White. The leaked listings indicate demo prices of Rs. 38,000 and Rs. 42,000, while another entry shows the 128GB model at Rs. 43,000. Previous leaks have also hinted at its launch timeline and key hardware specifications.
title: Vivo S2 Leak Reveals Expected Price and Storage Options Ahead of Rumoured India Launch

description: Microsoft on Wednesday announced the early release of Xbox Backward Compatibility on PC. The initiative aims to bring select games of the original Xbox console to Windows PCs and compatible handheld gaming consoles for the first time. Microsoft’s initial lineup includes four titles, including BLiNX: The Time Sweeper and Conker: Live and Reloaded, which are available through the Xbox app on PC and are included with every Xbox Game Pass tier.
title: Microsoft Launches Xbox Backward Compatibility on PC With Four Original Xbox Games: Check System Requirements

description: Oppo Find X10 series has been spotted in a leaked image, according to a report. The purported Oppo Find X10 series image hints at the design of the upcoming lineup, which is expected to include the Oppo Find X10, Find X10 Pro, and Find X10 Pro Max. The handsets were seen being tested with the iPhone 17 Pro. The company will reportedly redesign the rear camera module of the Oppo Find X10 series. The three handsets are shown to carry a triple rear camera setup, housed inside a rectangular camera module, similar to the iPhone 17 Pro’s camera plateau.
title: Oppo Find X10 Series Spotted Alongside iPhone 17 Pro in New Leak

description: Google Pixel Watch 5 is likely to be launched at the Made By Google event next month alongside the Pixel 11 series smartphones. Ahead of it, it was reportedly spotted on the Google Play Console website with the codename "godric". The listing shows that the wearable will run on Qualcomm's SW5100 platform. The same chip is found in Pixel Watch 2 and later models. The Pixel Watch 5 could come with 3GB of memory.
title: Pixel Watch 5 Spotted on Google Play Console Listing Revealing Key Specifications

description: OnePlus N6x will be launched in India on July 31 at 12 pm IST, the smartphone maker announced on Thursday. The new OnePlus N6x will debut in the country as the second model in the tech firm’s recently introduced N series. The handset is tipped to arrive with familiar specifications and features. The OnePlus N6x is confirmed to go on sale in India via Amazon and the OnePlus online store. The smartphone will be available for purchase in two colour options, namely Burgundy Red and Ice Blue. The handset is shown to feature a pill-shaped rear camera module.
title: OnePlus N6x India Launch Date Announced Days After Company Teased Design, Colour Options

description: iQOO Neo 11S has been rumoured to be in development for quite some time. It was previously anticipated to launch in China in July, but it did not happen. According to a new leak, the purported handset could finally make its debut soon. A tipster has shed light on its launch timeline, along with expected price and key specifications. The iQOO Neo 11S is expected to sit above the iQOO Neo 11 in the brand’s lineup. It is tipped to sport a 144Hz OLED screen and pack an 8,000mAh battery.
title: iQOO Neo 11S Launch Timeline, Price Leaked by Tipster; Could Get 2K 144Hz OLED Display

description: Apple is planning a major overhaul for the entire Mac lineup, according to a report. The Cupertino-based tech giant is said to be planning to refresh all the Mac devices it currently sells by next year. The report highlights that Apple wishes to “capitalise” on the growing demand for more powerful devices, which the unprecedented AI boom has reportedly fueled. While a few devices might arrive by the end of this year, other devices are said to launch next year. The company will reportedly first refresh the new 14-inch MacBook Pro, codenamed J804, with the Apple Silicon M6 processor, making it one of the first devices to feature the chipset.
title: Apple Plans to Overhaul Mac Lineup With Launch of New MacBook Pro, iMac and MacBook Neo Models: Report

description: Redmi 17C 5G could launch soon. Ahead of it, the handset has been spotted on Thailand's National Broadcasting and Telecommunications Commission (NBTC) certification website. An entry on the Bureau of Indian Standards (BIS) website hints at its upcoming launch in India. The Redmi 17C 5G reportedly surfaced on the BIS website with model number 2607FRNEAI. It could run on the MediaTek Dimensity 6300 SoC.
title: Redmi 17C 5G Spotted on BIS and NBTC Websites, Launch Could Be Near

description: The Nubia NaviX Ultra AI-agent smartphone has appeared in a new leak ahead of its expected unveiling at the World Artificial Intelligence Conference 2026. The handset is tipped to feature a 6.78-inch 1.5K 144Hz display, Qualcomm's Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5 chipset, a 7,100mAh battery and triple 50-megapixel rear cameras. The leak also details its AI capabilities and software architecture. Nubia has already confirmed the phone's name, design, colour options and Doubao AI assistant.
title: Nubia NaviX Ultra Key Specifications Leaked Ahead of AI-Agent Smartphone Debut

description: The Redmi Note 17 is expected to be launched in India next month. While the company has yet to confirm any details, the handset is rumoured to have similar specifications to its Chinese counterpart, which debuted earlier this month. Ahead of its anticipated debut, the Indian variant of the Redmi Note 17 has allegedly surfaced on a benchmarking site, revealing some of its key specifications. The handset is listed with the Snapdragon 4 Gen 4 chipset, paired with 8GB of RAM. It runs on Android 16.
title: Redmi Note 17 With Snapdragon 4 Gen 4 Chip Reportedly Listed on Geekbench Ahead of India Launch

description: Realme GT 8 Pro and Realme Neo 8 will get successors globally, according to a tipster. The company, to fill the gap in its device portfolio, will reportedly launch new numbered series handsets. Apart from smartphones, the tech firm reportedly also plans to launch new audio devices in select global markets. Moreover, Realme could be considering launching a new performance-focused gaming tablet globally, too. This comes a week after Realme’s President Xu Qi Chase announced that the smartphone maker is exiting the Chinese handset market.
title: Realme’s New GT and Neo Series Phones Tipped to Skip Global Launch Days After Firm Announced China Exit

description: Google has introduced an upgraded migration system in Android 17 that makes switching from an iPhone to an Android phone easier. The new built-in tool supports wireless transfer of additional data, including Google Account details, saved passwords, Wi-Fi credentials and eSIM information, alongside existing content such as photos, contacts and messages. The feature is rolling out to select Pixel devices and Samsung's Galaxy Z Flip 8 and Galaxy Z Fold 8, with wider Android support planned for the future.
title: Android 17 Makes Switching From iPhone Easier With Expanded Data Transfer Support

description: Poco X8 is said to be on the way to market. Ahead of the official announcement, the handset has been spotted on Thailand's National Broadcasting and Telecommunications Commission (NBTC) certification database. It has also been listed on Singapore's Infocomm Media Development Authority (IMDA) certification platform. The handset surfaced with model number 2607DPC18G.
title: Poco X8 Receives NBTC and IMDA Certifications; Launch Seems Imminent

description: Honor Pad X9 Max has been unveiled in select global markets by the Chinese tech firm. The tablet is currently on sale in the UK via the Honor online store in a single gray colourway. The Honor Pad X9 Max ships with Honor’s MagicOS 10, which is based on Android 16. The tablet sports a 13-inch 2.5K (2,500 x 1,560 pixels) LCD touchscreen, with up to 120Hz refresh rate, up to 700 nits peak brightness, 228 ppi pixel density, 88 percent screen-to-body ratio, and 1.07 billion colours. Powering the new Honor Pad X9 Max is octa core Snapdragon 6s Gen 2 chipset from Qualcomm.
title: Honor Pad X9 Max Launched With 13-Inch 2.5K Display, 10,100mAh Battery: Price, Specifications

description: Apple raised prices across much of its hardware portfolio in India last month. While iPads, Macs, and other smart home devices were affected by the price hikes, iPhones have been spared till now, but that may soon change. According to a tipster, the Cupertino-based tech giant could soon raise prices for the iPhone 17 series in India. Fresh iPhone stocks are reportedly expected to reach dealers in India by next weekend.
title: Apple Could Hike iPhone 17, iPhone 17 Pro Max Prices in India From August, Tipster Claims

description: WhatsApp on Wednesday announced a new set of features for its app across operating systems. The Meta-owned messaging platform now allows Apple users to create an account directly from an iPad. Further, it is also making it easier to share songs from Apple Music and Spotify directly to Status. Other new features include a redesigned experience for Apple CarPlay and Android Auto, along with the ability to edit PDFs directly within the WhatsApp chat window.
title: WhatsApp Rolling Out Direct iPad Sign-Up, Revamped CarPlay Experience and In-Chat PDF Editing

description: Samsung Galaxy Watch Ultra 2 launched with a 1.52-inch Super AMOLED display and Qualcomm's Snapdragon Wear Elite chipset. The new model has an IP69K rating, compared with the Galaxy Watch Ultra's IP68 rating and packs an 800mAh battery, compared to 590mAh on the original Galaxy Watch Ultra. Here's a quick comparison of the Samsung Galaxy Watch Ultra 2 with the Galaxy Watch Ultra.
title: Samsung Galaxy Watch Ultra 2 vs Galaxy Watch Ultra: What's the Difference in Price in India, Specifications?

description: Samsung held its second Galaxy Unpacked event of 2026 in London on Wednesday. At its bi-annual hardware showcase, the South Korean tech conglomerate introduced its latest Galaxy foldable smartphones and smartwatches. The highlight of this year’s event was the revamped foldable lineup comprising the Galaxy Z Fold 8 Ultra, the new wide-format Galaxy Z Fold 8, and the Galaxy Z Flip 8. Samsung also unveiled the Galaxy Watch Ultra 2 and Galaxy Watch 9.
title: Samsung Galaxy Unpacked July 2026 Event Roundup: Galaxy Z Fold 8, Z Fold 8 Ultra, Z Flip 8, Galaxy Watch Ultra 2, and Everything Else Announced

description: Samsung Galaxy Z Fold 8 was launched in India and other global markets on Wednesday, during the Galaxy Unpacked July 2026 event. The Samsung Galaxy Z Fold 8 is the first wide-folding smartphone. The new shape marks a shift for the entire Galaxy Z Fold lineup, as the tech giant is now taking a different approach to book-style foldables. However, the company has kept the taller book-style foldable as the Galaxy Z Fold 8 Ultra, which is reminiscent of previous book-style foldables. In recognition of different use cases, the Samsung Galaxy Z Fold 8’s cover display offers a 10:16 aspect ratio, while the foldable screen provides a 4:3 aspect ratio.
title: Samsung Galaxy Z Fold 8: Top 5 Features That Make It Stand Out
